name: thesis-bus-dual-aligned-v4
reward_contract: Chronological system transitions. Passenger cost increments telescope without overlapping vehicle windows or mean subtraction. Headway uses the existing rigid/ridge reward of the next selected event. Terminal headway feedback is zero; terminal passenger cost is retained.
action_contract: Exact zero-or-positive holding in [0,60] plus tanh speed factor in [0.8,1.2]. State extends the proven global event batch with speeds already selected in that batch. All policies and rules use identical executor per comparison.
selection: All paired seeds and fixed-budget endpoints retained. No tuning or selection against the ten previously used test cases; additional development interventions are reported as diagnosis, not fresh held-out confirmation.
preservation: Separate new data, policies and evaluations. Existing projects and successful holding/passenger artifacts remain unchanged.
